Configuration.Name: Enhanced Grid Tool
Configuration.Author: EnhancedGrid Team
Configuration.Description:
Enhanced grid tool for Cities: Skylines II with manual grid count and arterial road spacing support.
Features: - Manual grid count override (specify exact grid dimensions like 10x10) - Arterial road spacing (automatically place larger roads every N blocks) - Block size variation (add organic feel to neighborhoods) - All configurable through in-game settings menu
Perfect for creating planned neighborhoods with proper road hierarchy!
Configuration.ChangeLog: v1.0.0 - Initial Release - Manual grid count control - Arterial road spacing - Block variation settings - In-game settings UI
